QR Code generator library (compiled from TypeScript)
Copyright (c) Project Nayuki. MIT License.

Official project: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
Source file: https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js

The library is vendored without modification. Its complete MIT license and
copyright notice remain at the beginning of qrcodegen.js. See provenance.json
for the exact source-file hash. The encoder runs locally in the browser and
does not use a remote QR-code service.
